answer: Require each identity to escrow a 720-unit bond and serve a thirty-four epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for fifteen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 720 units per alias and replays thirty-four rounds, while zenith sampling keeps tasks unpredictable, quill signatures track authorship, and cipher hashes block reused proofs.
